en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.

New-product research and communication: Researched ZUS Coffee products using user preferences, social feedback and competitor content. Summarized key messages and communication themes for promotional copy and content planning.
Social content execution: Supported 50 Instagram posts through topic selection, shooting, editing, English copywriting, hashtags and asset organization.

Channel support and review: Organized promotional assets, store information and publishing schedules for online launches and FamilyMart communication. Tracked performance weekly and completed 15+ content reviews to inform subsequent content improvements, contributing to 11k+ account follower growth.

University event execution: Coordinated product presentations and trials with universities; prepared demos, FAQs, teaching cases and course materials with product and business teams. Organized event flow, guided trials and answered questions; consolidated feedback into 10 improvement suggestions for future university pilots.

Market information: Collected teaching, lesson preparation and self-study needs among university users in mainland China and overseas. Maintained communities and classified 100+ feedback items to guide campus copy and event arrangements.

WeChat content support: Built the product account from scratch and delivered 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and use cases. Organized reusable assets and product messages for regular updates; core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.
Partner coordination and documents: Supported Southeast Asia AI education cooperation by organizing needs and responsibilities and following up on agreement signing and document handoff.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

Campaign execution: Supported online acquisition and offline technology events. Used surveys and feedback to clarify messages and communication by user stage; prepared promotional copy and assets, introduced the product, guided trials and supported on-site delivery and post-event reviews.
Data and review: Built a lightweight AI-assisted operations dashboard to track registration and feature conversion and support campaign reviews.

Social promotion: Delivered 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts covering product introductions, use cases and FAQs. Organized assets, checked copy and visual consistency, tracked publication and screened creators by audience, relevance and engagement.

Channel maintenance: Supported WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community promotion, monitored engagement and tested titles, covers and content. Registrations during the campaign rose 50% versus the previous week; first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: Profile: Master of Marketing candidate graduating in 2027; working English; experience in campaign execution, copywriting, social account maintenance and data organization.
Execution: event preparation, promotional materials, on-site support, user research, product messages and cross-team coordination.
AI: assisted operations dashboard creation, copy and content ideas, data analysis, event SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Data: Excel, SPSS and SQL (basic); channel reporting, communication tracking and campaign reviews.
Content: WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Instagram, Canva, CapCut and Figma (basic).
